description: Inputs to execution-plan.json and the timed-execution manifest. The compiler schedules the timed work items of curation/tasks.json from their dependencies and estimateMinutes; nothing here removes or reprioritizes a requirement.

event.name: Indy Init 2026
event.source: docs/HACKATHON-BOUNDARIES.md: 'the build window is currently published as 9:30 AM to 5:00 PM on November 7, 2026.' Eastern Standard Time applies on 2026-11-07 (UTC-5).

clock.t0: The UTC instant written to the kickoff record (kickoff/<run>/t0.json, field t0) by the operator or the kickoff workflow when the timer starts; never chosen or edited by the implementing agent.
clock.deadline: min(t0 + 420 minutes, publishedBuildWindowUtc.end), written as an absolute UTC instant into the same kickoff record at T0.
rules: Every resumption and every time-based decision begins by reading the wall clock (date -u) and computing remaining = deadline - now from the recorded absolute deadline; never from timestamps remembered in the conversation (Rehearsal 7 lesson R7L-15).
Merge every pull request whose required checks are green and whose gates permit it immediately; never leave green work unmerged while idle.
Merge freeze at deadline - 45 minutes: after it only the final acceptance, deployment of the frozen SHA, evidence collection and delivery run.
Work after the deadline is never part of the timed result: the timed result is the state of main and the evidence at the deadline instant, and anything later is reported separately.

reserves.purpose: integration of parallel lanes and CI queue time not inside task estimates
final verification and delivery window: independent acceptance on the exact SHA, deployment, evidence collection, delivery (after the merge freeze)

independentReviewCheckpoints.purpose: early adversarial review of interfaces and invariants (DCC-002: target T+90 to T+120)
review after the live write path, before UI completion
architecture and invariant review before the release candidate
fresh reviewer before the final verdict

topologies.description: One lane per owner role (domain, ui, persistence, integration, coordinator, reviewer); operator and upstream lanes are preflight-only. Needs owner approval (ODR-V4-07, F-007).
One continuous lead agent for domain, ui, persistence, integration and coordinator work (AR-021); reviewer is a separate lane.

As A-role-lanes, with a second UI agent for the report, history/semantic diff, administration and causal graph views (T23, T26, T28, T29) after the integration checkpoint T17. Needs owner approval (ODR-V4-07).

ciRules: Every CI step runs with errexit and pipefail; conditor ci-policy check passes at kickoff and on every candidate (DCC-013).
Browser and PAT suites run to completion: no stop after the first failure, so every test yields PASS or FAIL (PERSIST-055).
Each CI run's live tests use their own branch of the test repository; live writers of different runs never share a branch (Rehearsal 7 R7L-18).
Every CI job that runs bound tests sets CAUSA_PLAN (DCC-015).
